jobs.title: Senior Product Data Scientist
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Sr. Product Data Scientist to join our growing Data team in our Product organization. This is a senior individual contributor role with broad scope across product insights, experimentation, modeling and applied analytics. The ideal candidate is not only technically strong, but also proactive in uncovering opportunities, framing insights, and ensuring leaders have the context they need to make the right calls. We are looking for this individual to bring analytical thought leadership as we continue to rapidly grow and iterate on our product offerings across Talkiatry.



You’ll own projects that range from producing growth and performance analyses that guide strategic and product decisions, to designing and evaluating experiments, to improving patient engagement and clinical efficiency. You’ll be expected to communicate insights proactively, frame results in business terms, and work closely with your core cross-functional teammates (Product, Engineering and Design) as well as stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, and Finance.




ABOUT TALKIATRY

Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co-founded by a patient and a triple-board-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Through our technology-powered, in-network platform, we’re changing that, creating a better experience for patients and empowering clinicians to focus on delivering exceptional care.



Today, Talkiatry is the largest dedicated psychiatry practice in the U.S., with 750+ psychiatrists, 250+ therapists, and more than two million patient visits delivered nationwide. At our scale, every innovation has real impact. Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.



Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.




YOU WILL:

Proactive Insights & Storytelling

 - Identify growth opportunities for the Product teams by analyzing data and understanding patient behaviors.

 - Help Product teams maximize impact, by working wtih PMs and engineers to understand costs and constraints, while looking at underlying data and making reasonable assumptions to size opportunities.

 - Identify risks by exploring data and monitoring trends to understand the impact of emerging issues before they become problems.

 - Frame analyses and estimates in terms of “so what” for the practice to ensure findings don’t just inform, but influence the team.

 - Develop regular deliverables that turn historical data into forward looking guidance for product and operational teams.

 - Anticipate questions our teams should be asking and bring forward insights before they’re requested.

Experimentation & Measurement

 - Partner with Product and Operations teams to design experiments, define success metrics, and implement robust statistical evaluation frameworks.

 - Ensure appropriate statistical power, so results are both valid and actionable.

 - Analyze experiment results and establish clear post experiment communication, ensuring learnings (positive or negative) are codified and inform future product or operational decisions.

Applied Analytics

 - Lead analyses on patient growth, clinician utilization, marketplace dynamics and more to surface actionable insights to leadership.

 - Translate adhoc analyses into repeatable frameworks and scalable reporting so insights don’t stay one-off, but become institutional knowledge.

Collaboration

 - Collaborate with Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering teams to define requirements and highlight gaps, so that data pipelines reliably support advanced analytics and modeling.

 - Act as a thought partner to Operations, Clinical, and Finance leaders, not just answering questions, but shaping the questions we should be asking.
   
   


YOU HAVE:

 - 4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or related fields, with a track record of delivering measurable business impact.

 - Advanced proficiency in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels and all other common data science packages) and SQL; experience with modern data warehouses (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery).

 - Strong foundation in experimental design, causal inference, and statistical methods.

 - Exceptional communication skills, displaying the ability to frame technical findings in a way that resonates with stakeholders.

 - Experience in DBT is a plus, but not required.

 - Experience on a Product growth team, where experimentation and opportunity identification were key aspects of the role, is a plus.

 - Strong applied experience in data science is essential; a Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field is a plus.





WHY TALKIATRY:

 - Top-notch team: we're a diverse, experienced group motivated to make a difference in mental health care

 - Collaborative environment: be part of building something from the ground up at a fast-paced startup

 - Excellent benefits: medical, dental, vision, effective day 1 of employment, 401K with match, generous PTO plus paid holidays, paid parental leave, and more!

 - Grow your career with us: hone your skills and build new ones with our Learning team as Talkiatry expands

 - It all comes back to care: we’re a mental health company, and we put our team’s well-being first

jobs.title: Senior Data Product Manager
jobs.description:
As a Senior Data Product Manager at Talkiatry, you will own the evolution of our data stack, end user data enablement strategy and our third party integrations (including referrals, billing and more). This role reaches into nearly every part of Talkiatry's practice, and asks you to balance day-to-day execution against a strategic view of how our data capabilities should evolve. You will partner closely with Referrals, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Engineering, and other Product teams to identify high-impact opportunities, define long-term direction, and deliver scalable solutions across Talkiatry's data ecosystem. This includes putting more capability directly in the hands of the people who need it: AI functionality, self-serve analytics, configurable attribution, and marketer-controlled segmentation that don't require an engineering ticket. You will expand our metrics and proprietary data layers so that the definitions the business runs on are trustworthy and owned. And you will grow the data foundation underneath our Referrals business and the features we offer partner organizations. This is a role for someone comfortable at two altitudes: system design, data flows, definitions, and integration debugging on one hand; roadmap, tradeoffs, and executive alignment on the other.

 


ABOUT TALKIATRY: 

Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co-founded by a patient and a triple-board-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.

 


YOU WILL:

 - Lead product strategy and execution for our data platform, third party integrations, and end user data enablement

 - Develop and maintain a long-term roadmap for the data stack, our metrics layers, proprietary data models and data user AI capabilities

 - Own third party integrations across referrals, billing, marketing, and clinical systems

 - Own data quality and reliability as product requirements, with validation, monitoring, and alerting that catch problems early

 - Identify where AI and automation add real value to end data users

 - Put analytics, attribution, and segmentation directly in the hands of Marketing, Operations, and Finance without engineering dependencies

 - Balance short-term operational priorities with long-term platform investments and scalability goals

 - Lead cross-functional collaboration with Engineering, Design, Data, Clinical, and Operations partners to deliver complex initiatives successfully

 - Anticipate dependencies across interconnected systems, drive alignment, and break ambiguous problems into prioritized opportunities

 - Define success metrics, establish measurable goals, and use data to evaluate product impact and inform strategic decisions

 - Navigate ambiguity by breaking down complex operational and systems challenges into actionable product opportunities




YOU HAVE:

 - 4+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years on data platform, data products, or data infrastructure

 - Working fluency with the modern data stack: ELT, cloud warehousing, transformation, orchestration, BI and semantic layers, and reverse ETL

 - Comfort reading and writing SQL, and the ability to reason independently about grain, joins, duplication, and completeness

 - Experience leading complex product initiatives across multiple teams and systems

 - Experience owning metric definitions and governance, including resolving competing definitions across teams

 - Track record of building self-serve data capability for non-technical teams and measurably reducing ad hoc request volume

 - Experience writing accurate, concise and up to date product documentation for Engineering and Design handoffs as well as stakeholder reviews

 - Demonstrated ability to develop product strategy, prioritize effectively, and execute against long-term roadmaps

 - Strong interest in AI-driven products, with the ability to identify practical applications of AI

 - Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including automation, large language models (LLMs), and decision-support systems

 - Experience working across interconnected systems and understanding technical dependencies, integrations, and operational trade-offs

 - Strong product judgment and ability to navigate ambiguity in complex problem spaces

 - Excellent communication and organizational skills, with the ability to clearly articulate priorities, trade-offs, and strategic rationale




WHY TALKIATRY:

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
Talkiatry is seeking a Staff Product Manager, Growth to help build our growth engine. You'll initially own our "Start to Visit" funnel, using rigorous analysis, experimentation, and strong product judgment to help more patients successfully begin care.

Growth at Talkiatry has a direct connection to our mission: when we make it easier for someone to discover Talkiatry, find the right clinician, and successfully begin and stay in care, more people get access to the mental health care they need.

You'll identify high-leverage opportunities, develop hypotheses, run rigorous A/B tests, and turn learnings into compounding engines.

Over time, your scope will expand across retention, LTV, organic growth, referrals, and product-led growth loops.

This is a high-impact Staff IC role for an exceptional growth product leader who combines analytical depth, systems thinking, and a relentless drive to learn and optimize.




 


ABOUT TALKIATRY: 

Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co-founded by a patient and a triple-board-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Through our technology-powered, in-network platform, we’re changing that, creating a better experience for patients and empowering clinicians to focus on delivering exceptional care.

 

Today, Talkiatry is the largest dedicated psychiatry practice in the U.S., with 750+ psychiatrists, 250+ therapists, and more than two million patient visits delivered nationwide. At our scale, every innovation has real impact. Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.

 

Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.

 


YOU WILL:

 - Own growth product strategy and execution, initially focused on materially improving the Start-to-Visit funnel.

 - Treat growth as a system: deeply understand the funnel, identify constraints and drop-off points, and find the highest-leverage opportunities.

 - Build a rigorous, high-velocity experimentation practice—develop hypotheses, run A/B tests, measure incremental impact, and compound learnings over time.

 - Use funnel analysis, segmentation, cohorts, and behavioral data to understand what is happening and why.

 - Balance continuous optimization with larger product bets that can unlock step-change growth.

 - Expand into retention, LTV, organic acquisition, referrals, and other compounding growth loops over time.

 - Partner deeply across engineering, design, data science, marketing, operations, and clinical teams to drive outcomes.





YOU HAVE:

 - 7+ years of product management experience, including significant experience building consumer growth products.

 - A track record of materially improving conversion, activation, retention, engagement, or LTV at scale.

 - Exceptional analytical horsepower and fluency with funnels, experimentation, metrics, and behavioral data.

 - Deep expertise in A/B testing, including hypothesis development, experiment design, measurement, and interpretation.

 - Strong systems thinking and an ability to find leverage within complex customer journeys.

 - Exceptional rigor and attention to detail. You interrogate assumptions, dig beneath topline metrics, and care deeply about getting the answer right.

 - Strong product judgment—you know when to optimize, when to keep learning, and when a problem requires a fundamentally different solution.

 - The ability to operate independently in ambiguity and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

 - Experience in a world-class consumer growth organization is strongly preferred.




WHY TALKIATRY:

 - Top-notch team: we're a diverse, experienced group motivated to make a difference in mental health care

 - Collaborative environment: be part of building something from the ground up at a fast-paced startup

 - Excellent benefits: medical, dental, vision, effective day 1 of employment, 401K with match, generous PTO plus paid holidays, paid parental leave, and more!

 - Grow your career with us: hone your skills and build new ones with our Learning team as Talkiatry expands
